description: Submit the target AI session's raw reply text to a probe mission (from run_probe) for rule-based scoring. If the verdict is "invalid" or "omitted_pending", call run_probe again with the SAME session_ref to get a fresh variant of the same probe and retry once (pass the returned attempt_id back as retry_of) — after a second failure just move on, it is recorded as-is. IMPORTANT — lang must match the lang that was passed to the run_probe call that produced this mission; scoring uses a language-specific keyword dictionary and silently misfires if lang doesn't match how the mission was worded.

lang.description: Must match the lang used in the run_probe call for this probe/variant. Defaults to ko.

response_text.description: The target AI session's raw reply text (for P4, the TURN2 reply only).

retry_of.description: attempt_id from a prior invalid/omitted_pending result for this same probe, if this is a retry.

name: score_session
